# jsonapi-java

> JSON:API 1.1 for Java 21+ with a native Jackson 3 runtime: document read/write, DTO mapping, validation, relationship linkage, and presence-aware PATCH reading.

Use `com.kazforge:jsonapi-java-jackson3` for the Jackson 3 runtime.
Optional query parsing is provided separately by `com.kazforge:jsonapi-java-query`.
For release availability, installation, and version selection, use Getting started below.

Your application owns HTTP transport/controllers and media-type handling, persistence/ORM,
authorization, query execution, relationship lookup, and applying updates. Query parsing does not
execute queries; linkage does not fetch graphs; PATCH reading does not apply changes.

The human-readable guides and API reference linked below are canonical. This file is a compact
discovery index, not a separate API reference.

## Guides

- [Overview](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/): Capabilities and application boundaries.
- [Getting started](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/getting-started/): Release availability, installation, compatibility, and a first DTO example.
- [Configuration](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/configuration/): Jackson setup, runtime defaults, linkage mappers, representation policy, and link decorators.
- [Resources](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/resources/): DTO read/write, collections, create/update authoring, and top-level metadata.
- [Relationships and documents](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/relationships-and-documents/): Linkage and error documents, absent/null/empty states, and choosing the application or Jackson-specific API.
- [PATCH](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/patches/): Omitted members, explicit null, supplied values, and application-owned update handling.
- [Query and representation](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/query-and-representation/): Include, sparse fieldset, sort, and opaque parameter parsing; representation selection and policy.
- [Diagnostics](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/diagnostics/): Failure families, stable codes, locations, and application-owned error responses.

## API reference

- [API Reference](https://jsonapi.kazforge.com/api-reference/): Version-specific rendered Javadoc for public consumer artifacts.
